name: Amazon EMR
overview: Amazon EMR runs big-data frameworks such as Spark/Hadoop on managed clusters or supported serverless deployments.
examSignals: Need managed Spark/Hadoop environment and cluster/framework control: EMR
Managed serverless SQL ETL with less cluster management: Glue
Ad hoc SQL on S3: Athena

compareWith.diff: EMR exposes broader big-data framework/runtime control; Glue provides managed ETL/catalog workflows.
